run_multiturn_cache_hit_test: run a multi-turn cache hit rate test against an SGLang server with configurable rounds and clients
async_request_sglang_generate: send a streaming generate request to an SGLang server and collect cache hit metrics
async_request_openai_chat_completions: send a streaming chat completions request to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and collect cache metrics
gen_payload: generate a JSON payload for the SGLang /generate endpoint with input tokens and sampling parameters
gen_payload_openai: generate a JSON payload for an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint with messages and max tokens
